claim_text: During prolonged exercise with substantial sweat loss, fluid and sodium replacement may be relevant, but strategy depends on duration, environment, individual sweat losses, product composition and health status.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe, indication-specific recommendations and avoid unsupported supplementation.

population.other_context: People undertaking prolonged exercise with high sweat loss.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Relevant dietary and supplemental forms; verify exact product label and formulation.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Exercise and Athletic Performance materials provide exercise nutrition context.
limitations: No universal electrolyte formula; kidney/heart disease and medication context affect safety.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
